what_works: Geopolitical power rankings and comparisons involving India (Top 5 Powerful देश: 3378 views; India's Maritime Boundary: 2314 views; 1962 War: 2617 views; India's Highest-Earning Cities: 3516 views).
Bilingual or Hindi-dominant titles with high-contrast emojis (🔥, 😱, 🇮🇳, 👑) which average significantly higher view counts than pure English academic titles.
Morning publication slots (06:00 to 09:00 IST), which account for 8 of the channel's top 10 best-performing videos.
Custom thumbnails on historical and comparison topics, which correlate with crossing the 1,500+ view threshold.
Contrarian or high-stakes national curiosity hooks ('India को दुनिया हल्के में लेती है...', 'क्या UK टूटने वाला है?').

diagnosis.hook: Underperforming scripts open with passive rhetorical questions ('Do you know how...', 'Can a South Indian king...') in formal English. This creates an immediate bounce within 2 seconds. Winning shorts punch immediately with high-stake Hindi assertions, country comparisons, or bold numerical claims.
diagnosis.buildup: Weak videos progress like Wikipedia summaries, reciting chronological dates (1019 AD, September 1660) and troop names. Successful shorts maintain tension through antagonist-protagonist framing (US vs North Korea, India vs China) or escalating countdown structures.
diagnosis.visuals: Low-performing videos lack custom thumbnails (7 of the 10 worst have no custom thumbnail). Furthermore, relying on generic uniform tags ('indian', 'mongol') suggests static AI art or stock imagery without cinematic motion graphics, on-screen dynamic text, or fast camera zooms.
diagnosis.titles_topics: Severe niche confusion. When the channel sticks to Indian pride, defense, geopolitics, and city wealth, it clears 1,500-3,500 views. When it suddenly pivots to school science ('Photosynthesis') or foreign biology/history ('Mantis Shrimp', 'Battle of Myeongnyang') with dry English titles, views crash under 100.
diagnosis.other: Recency bias accounts for part of the lowest numbers (some were posted under 5 days ago), but videos like Mantis Shrimp (11 days, 24 views) and Photosynthesis (17 days, 28 views) prove that audience-mismatched topics are permanently rejected by the algorithm.

hook_rules: Ban question openings like 'Do you know...'; replace with shocking assertions (e.g., '1660 में 500 मराठा सैनिकों ने 10,000 की सेना को घुटनों पर ला दिया!').
Drop the core conflict or stakes within the first 1.5 seconds; mention a recognizable figure, country, or massive number immediately.
Deliver the hook in natural spoken Hindi, matching the visual on-screen text word-for-word.
Use sudden sound and visual pattern interrupts (hard cut, sound swoosh, red highlight) on beat one.
Introduce an open loop immediately ('लेकिन आखिरी 10 मिनट में जो हुआ उसने इतिहास बदल दिया').
buildup_rules: Cut all calendar dates (e.g., 'In 1019 AD'); replace with relatable relative stakes ('1000 साल पहले' or 'जब पूरी सल्तनत कांप उठी').
Structure every short around three escalating narrative beats: The Threat, The Stand, and The Climax.
Cap every script beat at maximum 5-7 seconds before changing the visual or narrative direction.
Place the payoff at second 38-42 of a 45-second short, ending sharply without drawn-out outros or subscription begging.
visual_rules: Mandate a high-contrast custom thumbnail featuring an Indian flag, map graphic, or dramatic historical face.
Ensure a visual cut, punch zoom, or asset transition every 1.8 to 2.5 seconds.
Use large, centered, two-tone Hindi dynamic subtitles (yellow/white with black stroke) for mobile readability.
Show animated motion maps for troop movements rather than static portrait paintings.
title_rules: Use Hinglish/Bilingual framing: English keyword for search + Hindi hook for emotion (e.g., 'Chola Empire: 2500 KM चलकर गंगा को कैसे जीता? 🚩').
Always include 1-2 emotional or national emojis (🇮🇳, 🔥, 😱, ⚔️) to draw the eye in the Shorts feed.
Keep visible titles under 50 characters so the core mystery does not get truncated on mobile.
Double-check title metadata before publishing to prevent accidental text errors like 'Description:'.
topic_rules: Focus 80% of content on India-centric defense, military history, geopolitical rivalries, and comparative wealth/power.
Filter every idea through the audience relevance test: 'Does an average Indian viewer feel pride, curiosity, or shock?'
Eliminate textbook science lessons and isolated foreign trivia unless directly tied to an Indian perspective.
avoid: Generic school topics (Photosynthesis, Cell Biology, Concrete chemistry).
English-only academic titles without curiosity or emotional triggers.
Chronological lecture scripts that read like history textbooks.
Publishing between 11:00 AM and 4:00 PM IST; prioritize early morning 06:30 - 08:30 IST.
